description: E14 multi-turn continuity gold set. Each case is a complaint that makes the Severity-Classifier propose a clarifying question and the HITL policy node choose `ask` (verified against the live pipeline, LLM disabled, 2026-09-17; re-verified 2026-09-23 after the 22 -> 51 category widening, which made the musculoskeletal complaints (back pain, knee) classify confidently (0.86-0.90) and stop reaching the ask branch, so they were replaced by complaints that still do; re-pinned again 2026-09-23 after the retrain on the corrected features ("feeling off today" now classifies at 0.52) — these are the inputs that actually reach the ask branch, not inputs that look like they should). `answer` is what the patient replies on the second turn; `implies` says what that answer means clinically, so a decision that ignores it can be told apart from one that acts on it. Turn 2 replays the SAME raw_text with the answer carried on the request, which is how the design intends a resumed case to work: stateless and fully replayable.

cases.text: I feel a bit off today
cases.answer: yes, I also have a fever and I am struggling to breathe
cases.note: The asked gap is present after all. A resumed run that ignores this reaches the same decision as one told nothing.

cases.text: I feel a bit off today
cases.answer: no fever, and my breathing is completely normal
cases.note: The asked gap is absent. The question was asked to resolve uncertainty, so a denial should resolve it.

cases.answer: yes, high fever since last night and shortness of breath
no fever at all and no trouble breathing
yes I have a fever too
